trap.label: that com vírgula
trap.wrong: The Nile, that supports farming, floods every year.
trap.right: The Nile, which supports farming, floods every year.
trap.why: Em português “que” serve para os dois tipos de oração. Em inglês, a não restritiva (com vírgulas) nunca usa that: use which/who.

opts: Cities that grew by rivers thrived.
The Nile, which supports farming, floods.
Settlements ___ grew beside rivers developed faster.
The capital, ___ is old, is busy.
The valley, that is fertile, is wide.
The valley which, is fertile, is wide.
The valley, which is fertile, is wide.

fix.wrong: Trade routes, that were busy, linked the cities.
fix.right: Trade routes, which were busy, linked the cities.

fix.wrong: The capital city, who is ancient, is dry.
fix.right: The capital city, which is ancient, is dry.

fix.wrong: Farmers which lived beside rivers did well.
fix.right: Farmers who lived beside rivers did well.

rewrite.prompt: Una com vírgulas (não restritiva): “Cairo is old. Cairo lies on the Nile.” (use which)
rewrite.answer: Cairo, which lies on the Nile, is old.

rewrite.prompt: Una como restritiva com that: “Towns grew fast. The towns stood beside rivers.”
rewrite.answer: Towns that stood beside rivers grew fast.

rewrite.prompt: Troque that por which, com vírgulas: “The valley that is wide floods.” (The valley, …)
rewrite.answer: The valley, which is wide, floods.
